nodes.Name: Erfinv
nodes.DocComment:
Erfinv returns the inverse error function of x.

Special cases are:

	Erfinv(1) = +Inf
	Erfinv(-1) = -Inf
	Erfinv(x) = NaN if x < -1 or x > 1
	Erfinv(NaN) = NaN

nodes.Name: Erfcinv
nodes.DocComment:
Erfcinv returns the inverse of [Erfc](x).

Special cases are:

	Erfcinv(0) = +Inf
	Erfcinv(2) = -Inf
	Erfcinv(x) = NaN if x < 0 or x > 2
	Erfcinv(NaN) = NaN
